in_hebrew.name: Lyssa

Her name derives from the Greek word 'lyssos', meaning 'loosener', due to her ability to unleash wild, untamed emotions. In Christianity, Lyssa represents the transformative power of the Holy Spirit, turning chaos into divine order.
